race.comment: ANABALLISTIC (6) made it back-to-back wins last start in this company at Belmont. She's been freshened since, but that isn't an issue with her first-up record. Tsang's claim comes in handy and he has a good record aboard the mare. Can bring up the hat-trick in this suitable assignment. LONG SERVICE LEAF (2) was backed into favourite here last week but disappointed and there was no real excuse as to why. Parnham sticks with him and the tongue tie goes on for the first time. In an easier assignment now and he can bounce back to what he showed last campaign. HEZANGELIC (1) has the speed to work across from the barrier and was strong in defeat last week. Back to 1000m is a big tick and he can make his presence felt. ROSTISLAV (5) has been off the scene since the Placid Ark last year, but his latest trial was strong and suggests he can fire a shot on resumption. GREAT EMOTION (9) comes here without a trial, but Pike's booking and her first-up record brings her into calculations.
